blind.B1: Yes. RCT in women after RYGB: RYGB+exercise training (ET) vs RYGB alone (abstract; GEO overall design). Exercise factor is carried by the 12 RYGB+ET samples (6 women x PRE/POST9); 12 RYGB-alone samples are the randomized control; 6 lean controls baseline only (GEO overall design). Within-arm POST vs PRE mixes surgery, weight loss and training.
blind.B2: Abstract gives no explicit DE contrasts. Likely RYGB+ET POST9 vs PRE and RYGB POST9 vs PRE, 6 women each (12 samples per arm); exercise-specific = difference in change between arms; lean (n=6) as reference. 3-month biopsies are not in GEO.
blind.B3: Yes. Each woman biopsied PRE and POST9. Packet A key `subject` (arm+num from title) links 24/30 samples, no duplicates within a level; lean women single-sampled.
blind.B4: Paper text unavailable (abstract only); it does not say joint or pairwise. GEO data_processing names DESeq2 V1.18.1 and JMP ANOVA only.
blind.B5: Not stated in abstract or GEO; no DEG counts reported in the available text.

ETpost vs ETpre, RYpost vs RYpre, LEAN as reference for lean comparisons; DEG file names match treatment_vs_control.
